title: MCP: library_import_bitmap and library_import_sound tools missing
description: There are no MCP tools for importing bitmaps or sounds into the library. An agent cannot add BitmapItem or SoundItem to doc.library without replacing the entire document via doc_load. Add tools: library_import_bitmap (accepts base64 image data + optional name) and library_import_sound (accepts base64 audio data + name, mimeType). These should call the existing addBitmapToLibrary / addSoundToLibrary model functions if they exist, or create the library items directly.
